# Correlation figures: summary scores and SEM
```{r}
ord <- c("TPi", "TLetter", "TGabor", "SPi", "SLetter", "SGabor",
         "OSpan", "CSpan", "Corsi", "Matrix")
lab <- c(TPi = "Pi", TLetter = "Letter", TGabor = "Gabor",
         SPi = "Pi", SLetter = "Letter", SGabor = "Gabor",
         OSpan = "OSPAN", CSpan = "CSPAN", Corsi = "SSPAN", Matrix = "UCMRT")
grp <- c(TPi = "T", TLetter = "T", TGabor = "T",
         SPi = "S", SLetter = "S", SGabor = "S",
         OSpan = "C", CSpan = "C", Corsi = "C", Matrix = "C")
grp_pch  <- c(T = 15, S = 17, C = 16)            # square, triangle, circle
grp_name <- c(T = "Temporal masking", S = "Spatial masking", C = "Cognitive task")
n <- length(ord)

## ---- Data ------------------------------------------------------------------
clean <- read.csv("Data/summary/all_scores_clean.csv", check.names = FALSE)
R_sum <- cor(clean[, ord], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")   # excluded scores are NA
Z_sum <- scale(clean[, ord])

R_sem <- as.matrix(read.csv("Data/summary/sem_corr_mean.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE))[ord, ord]
theta <- read.csv("Data/summary/sem_theta.csv", check.names = FALSE)
theta <- merge(theta, clean[, c("id", "OSpan", "CSpan", "Corsi", "Matrix")], by = "id")
Z_sem <- scale(theta[, ord])

## ---- Colours -------------------------------------------------------------
INK   <- "#1f1f1d"
MUTED <- "#6b6a63"
HIST  <- "#4a4a46"
PANEL <- "#f7f7f5"
pal   <- colorRampPalette(c("#c43a39", "#e34948", "#f0efec",
                            "#86b6ef", "#2a78d6", "#184f95"))(256)
lim   <- 0.6                                      # colour scale runs from -lim to +lim
r2col <- function(r) pal[round((pmin(pmax(r, -lim), lim) + lim) / (2 * lim) * 255) + 1]
txtcol <- function(fill) {
  rgb <- col2rgb(fill) / 255
  if (sum(c(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722) * rgb) < 0.45) "white" else INK
}
fmt_r <- function(r) sub("^(-?)0\\.", "\\1.", sprintf("%.2f", r))

## ---- Layout (inches) ------------------------------------------------------
Wt <- 12.5                     # total width
Hc <- 3.8                      # height of the dendrogram panel (C)
Ha <- 7.4                      # height of the top row (A and B)
print_w <- 6.5                 # printed width (inches) when included with out.width = "100%"
ps <- 12 * Wt / print_w        # pointsize: cex = 1 prints at 12 pt, the size of the caption
Ht <- Ha + Hc                  # total height
to_fig <- function(x1, x2, y1, y2) c(x1 / Wt, x2 / Wt, y1 / Ht, y2 / Ht)

## ---- A: full correlation matrix -------------------------------------------
draw_A <- function(R, Z) {
  y0 <- Hc + 1.55; mat_h <- Ha - 1.55 - 0.45; cs <- mat_h / n
  x0 <- 1.75; gap <- 0.018
  breaks <- seq(-4.5, 4.5, by = 0.5)
  for (i in seq_len(n)) for (j in seq_len(n)) {
    par(fig = to_fig(x0 + (j - 1) * cs + gap, x0 + j * cs - gap,
                     y0 + mat_h - i * cs + gap, y0 + mat_h - (i - 1) * cs - gap),
        new = TRUE, mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
    a <- ord[i]; b <- ord[j]
    if (i == j) {                                 # diagonal: histogram
      hist(pmin(pmax(Z[, a], -4.5), 4.5), breaks = breaks, col = HIST, border = "white",
           main = "", xlab = "", ylab = "", axes = FALSE)
      abline(h = 0, col = MUTED, lwd = 0.6)
    } else if (i > j) {                           # lower triangle: correlation
      plot.new(); plot.window(c(0, 1), c(0, 1), xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i")
      fill <- r2col(R[a, b])
      rect(0, 0, 1, 1, col = fill, border = NA)
      text(0.5, 0.5, fmt_r(R[a, b]), col = txtcol(fill), cex = 0.62)
    } else {                                      # upper triangle: scatter
      plot.new(); plot.window(c(-4.2, 4.2), c(-4.2, 4.2), xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i")
      rect(-4.2, -4.2, 4.2, 4.2, col = PANEL, border = NA)
      points(Z[, b], Z[, a], pch = 16, cex = 0.3, col = adjustcolor(MUTED, 0.7))
    }
  }
  # overlay in inch coordinates
  par(fig = c(0, 1, 0, 1), new = TRUE, mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
  plot.new(); plot.window(c(0, Wt), c(0, Ht), xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i")
  x_mid <- x0 + (seq_len(n) - 0.5) * cs; y_mid <- y0 + mat_h - (seq_len(n) - 0.5) * cs
  x_end <- x0 + n * cs
  text(x_mid + 0.08, y0 - 0.1, lab[ord], srt = 45, adj = c(1, 1), cex = 0.75, col = INK)
  text(x0 - 0.09, y_mid, lab[ord], adj = 1, cex = 0.75, col = INK)
  for (k in c(3, 6)) {
    segments(x0 + k * cs, y0, x0 + k * cs, y0 + mat_h, col = INK, lwd = 0.9)
    segments(x0, y0 + mat_h - k * cs, x_end, y0 + mat_h - k * cs, col = INK, lwd = 0.9)
  }
  blocks <- list(list(1, 3, "Temporal"), list(4, 6, "Spatial"),
                 list(7, 10, "Cognitive"))
  for (bk in blocks) {
    j1 <- bk[[1]]; j2 <- bk[[2]]
    xa <- x0 + (j1 - 1) * cs + 0.04; xb <- x0 + j2 * cs - 0.04; yb <- y0 - 0.95
    segments(xa, yb, xb, yb, lwd = 3, lend = 1, col = INK)
    text((xa + xb) / 2, yb - 0.3, bk[[3]], cex = 0.83, col = INK)
    ya <- y0 + mat_h - (j1 - 1) * cs - 0.04; yz <- y0 + mat_h - j2 * cs + 0.04; xl <- x0 - 1.05
    segments(xl, ya, xl, yz, lwd = 3, lend = 1, col = INK)
    text(xl - 0.28, (ya + yz) / 2, bk[[3]], srt = 90, cex = 0.83, col = INK)
  }
  cb_x <- x_end + 0.12; cb_w <- 0.09                                    # colour bar
  cb_y <- seq(y0, y0 + mat_h, length.out = length(pal) + 1)
  rect(cb_x, head(cb_y, -1), cb_x + cb_w, tail(cb_y, -1), col = pal, border = NA)
  ticks <- c(-0.6, -0.3, 0, 0.3, 0.6)
  ty <- y0 + (ticks + lim) / (2 * lim) * mat_h
  segments(cb_x + cb_w, ty, cb_x + cb_w + 0.06, ty, col = MUTED)
  text(cb_x + cb_w + 0.1, ty, sprintf("%.1f", ticks), adj = 0, cex = 0.67, col = INK)
  text(cb_x + cb_w + 0.85, y0 + mat_h / 2, "Correlation", srt = 90, cex = 0.75, col = INK)
  text(0.1, Ht - 0.1, "A", font = 2, cex = 1, adj = c(0, 1), col = INK)
}

## ---- B: masking x cognitive sub-matrices (3 x 4 each) ----------------------
## Left: temporal masking tasks vs. the four cognitive tasks; right: spatial masking
## tasks vs. the same four. The average of the 12 correlations is printed below each.
draw_B <- function(R) {
  pan <- list(Temporal = ord[1:3], Spatial = ord[4:6])   # rows of each panel
  cog <- ord[7:10]                                       # columns of each panel
  cs  <- 0.36                                            # cell size (inches)
  xs  <- c(9.20, 10.89)                                  # left edge of the two panels
  y0  <- 7.60                                            # bottom edge of the panels
  plot.window(c(0, Wt), c(0, Ht), xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i")
  for (p in 1:2) {
    S <- R[pan[[p]], cog, drop = FALSE]                  # 3 x 4 block of correlations
    for (i in 1:3) for (j in 1:4) {
      xl <- xs[p] + (j - 1) * cs; yt <- y0 + (4 - i) * cs
      fill <- r2col(S[i, j])
      rect(xl + 0.02, yt - cs + 0.02, xl + cs - 0.02, yt - 0.02, col = fill, border = NA)
      text(xl + cs / 2, yt - cs / 2, fmt_r(S[i, j]), col = txtcol(fill), cex = 0.62)
    }
    xc <- xs[p] + 2 * cs                                 # panel centre
    text(xs[p] + (1:4 - 0.5) * cs + 0.07, y0 - 0.08, lab[cog],
         srt = 45, adj = c(1, 1), cex = 0.62, col = INK)           # column labels
    text(xc, y0 + 3 * cs + 0.28, names(pan)[p], cex = 0.83, col = INK)   # panel title
    text(xc, y0 - 0.90, paste0("Mean r = ", fmt_r(mean(S))), cex = 0.72, col = INK)
  }
  text(xs[1] - 0.1, y0 + (3:1 - 0.5) * cs, lab[pan[[1]]], adj = 1, cex = 0.62, col = INK)  # row labels
  text(8.95, Ht - 0.1, "B", font = 2, cex = 1, adj = c(0, 1), col = INK)
}

## ---- C: hierarchical clustering ---------------------------------------------
draw_C <- function(R, y_lo, h_max) {                                      # shared axis range across figures
  hc   <- hclust(as.dist(1 - R), method = "average")
  dend <- reorder(as.dendrogram(hc), wts = seq_len(n), agglo.FUN = mean)   # follows the order in ord; masking tasks to the left
  leaves <- ord[order.dendrogram(dend)]
  y_hi <- h_max + 0.26                                                      # headroom for the legend
  par(fig = to_fig(0, Wt, 0, Hc), new = TRUE, mar = c(2.2, 4, 0.8, 0.5), xpd = FALSE, yaxs = "i")
  plot(dend, leaflab = "none", ylim = c(y_lo, y_hi), yaxt = "n", edgePar = list(col = INK, lwd = 1.4))
  axis(2, at = seq(y_lo, h_max + 0.06, by = 0.10), las = 1, cex.axis = 0.67,
       col = MUTED, col.axis = INK, tcl = -0.3, mgp = c(3, 0.6, 0))
  mtext("Distance", side = 2, line = 2.6, cex = 0.75)
  par(xpd = NA)
  points(seq_len(n), rep(y_lo, n), pch = grp_pch[grp[leaves]], cex = 1, col = INK)
  text(seq_len(n), y_lo - 0.09 * (y_hi - y_lo), lab[leaves], cex = 0.75, col = INK)
  legend(x = 0.5, y = y_hi, xjust = 0, yjust = 1, legend = grp_name, pch = grp_pch,
         col = INK, bty = "n", cex = 0.75, pt.cex = 0.9, y.intersp = 0.9)
  par(fig = c(0, 1, 0, 1), new = TRUE, mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0), xpd = NA)
  plot.new(); plot.window(c(0, Wt), c(0, Ht), xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i")
  text(0.1, Hc - 0.05, "C", font = 2, cex = 1, adj = c(0, 1), col = INK)
}

make_figure <- function(R, Z, out_file, y_lo, h_max) {
  png(out_file, width = Wt, height = Ht, units = "in", res = 300, pointsize = ps)
  par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0), oma = c(0, 0, 0, 0)); plot.new()
  draw_A(R, Z)
  draw_B(R)
  draw_C(R, y_lo, h_max)
  dev.off()
}

# shared y-axis range for panel C in both figures
heights <- c(hclust(as.dist(1 - R_sum), method = "average")$height,
             hclust(as.dist(1 - R_sem), method = "average")$height)
y_lo  <- floor((min(heights) - 0.05) * 10) / 10
h_max <- max(heights)

make_figure(R_sum, Z_sum, "Figure/summary.png", y_lo, h_max)   # summary scores
make_figure(R_sem, Z_sem, "Figure/sem.png", y_lo, h_max)   # model estimates
```

Leverage

```{r}
all_scores <- read.csv("Data/summary/all_scores.csv", check.names = FALSE)
out_file   <- "Figure/leverage.png"
perc_tasks <- c("TLetter", "TGabor", "TPi", "SLetter", "SGabor", "SPi")
lab <- c(TLetter = "Backward Letter", TGabor = "Backward Gabor", TPi = "Backward Pi",
         SLetter = "Spatial Letter",  SGabor = "Spatial Gabor",  SPi = "Spatial Pi")

# log thresholds, z-scored within task (same scale as the SD screen)
Z <- all_scores
Z[perc_tasks] <- lapply(log(all_scores[perc_tasks]), function(x) as.numeric(scale(x)))

outlier_id <- 21
panels <- list(A = c("TLetter", "SGabor"),   # outlier on one task only: little leverage
               B = c("TGabor",  "SGabor"))   # outlier on both tasks: high leverage

png(out_file, width = 8, height = 4, units = "in", res = 300)
par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(4.2, 4.2, 2, 1), mgp = c(2.6, 0.7, 0))
for (p in names(panels)) {
  x <- Z[[panels[[p]][1]]]; y <- Z[[panels[[p]][2]]]
  out   <- Z$id == outlier_id
  r_all <- cor(x, y); r_wo <- cor(x[!out], y[!out])

  plot(x, y, type = "n", xlim = c(-3, 7.5), ylim = c(-3, 7.5), las = 1,
       xlab = paste(lab[panels[[p]][1]]), ylab = paste(lab[panels[[p]][2]]))
  abline(lm(y ~ x), col = "#c43a39", lwd = 1.6)                          # with the outlier
  abline(lm(y[!out] ~ x[!out]), col = "grey40", lwd = 1.6, lty = 2)     # without the outlier
  points(x[!out], y[!out], pch = 16, cex = 0.8, col = adjustcolor("grey30", 0.7))
  points(x[out],  y[out],  pch = 16, cex = 1.4, col = "#c43a39")
  legend("bottomright", bty = "n", cex = 0.8,
         legend = c(sprintf("With outlier: r = %.2f", r_all), sprintf("Without: r = %.2f", r_wo)),
         col = c("#c43a39", "grey40"), lty = c(1, 2), lwd = 1.6)
  mtext(p, side = 3, line = 0.5, adj = 0, font = 2, cex = 1.1)
}
dev.off()
```
